title: DocumentFrontmatter
description: Standard YAML frontmatter metadata for living documentation files.

id.description: Unique document identifier (e.g., ARCH-001, ADR-0001, GDD-COMBAT, GUIDE-LIVING-DOCS).

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the document.

owner.description: Team or individual accountable for document accuracy.

lastReviewed.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when this document was last verified against code.

appliesTo.description: Codebase paths, modules, or sub-systems documented by this file.

relatedDocs.description: Relative paths to related documentation files.
